{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Replace commas in 'revenue' with empty string to handle thousand separators
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)

# Convert to numeric
df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue_clean'], errors='coerce')

# Check for remaining non-numeric values
remaining_na = df['revenue_numeric'].isna().sum()

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue_completed = completed_orders['revenue_numeric'].mean()

remaining_na, mean_revenue_completed"}
